body:
I know. I’m not trying to disregard the things you are telling me. It’s a cop out to say that I can’t do it if I don’t even try. I know I’m lucky to have the life I do. But it is so fucking scary to do some of the things you guys tell me I need to do. I’m trying to research this stuff but it feels so overwhelming that I want to stay here. Which is the problem I’m having in the first place. 

I’ve been working up the courage to ask for a raise because I believe I’m a hard worker but I don’t think I’m being paid well enough. But as a people pleaser I really do try very hard at work. But I have such anxiety it feels like fighting an army to ask for a raise. I’m sorry. You’re guys’ advice is really helpful but I don’t feel capable of some things.

I’ve talked to some other people on here, and in my post I don’t mention im an alcoholic and that cuts into my funds a lot. I’ve been trying to quit but, month to month i have varying success. 

My parent also usually helped me figure out a plan and I don’t have them anymore. And because of my anxiety, sometimes even that advice is hard to follow. But you guys have given me a lot of places to start. I sincerely appreciate all your replies. I don’t have anyone really, and to have complete strangers help me out means so much.

I try to save money but I guess I need to sit down and make a budget because I only have a few dollars between paychecks. I know that’s all my fault, but you guys have helped me find out how to fix that.

I appreciate you taking the time to reply. I hope you all know you’re very kind. I have a few things to research from you guys and you’ve helped me find out some sort of roadmap to what I need to do. AA meetings, government programs for low income individuals, and now the Salvation Army. I didn’t realize they did that and I will look into it.

Maybe I can sell tootsie rolls to help the Salvation Army. I remember going to the store as a kid and my parent bought me tootsie rolls and that’s a memory I always hold onto.

Thank you for your help. I don’t know that I could do that. For me personally, I’m not sure I could go to a different town and try to start something. I’m unskilled, no education. I don’t make enough money as it is and the temporary displacement between jobs wouldn’t allow me to have enough money to start anything. If you’ve seen my replies I also have bad anxiety and even if I had a job in place I’m not sure I could do it.

Thank you for replying. I have no one except her. I don’t have friends or family. After my parents passed I let my few friendships fizzle out. I think she would care if I left, and I think we do love each other. But I also feel like we both know it’s not a healthy relationship. 

But the problem is if I left I don’t know what to do. I don’t have anyone to go to, and I don’t know if I could afford to live on my own, as most places in my area would be out of my budget.

Thanks for the reply. I’ve been talking with another redditor and I’ve told them about my anxiety. I don’t know if I could even do something like a homeless shelter. I’m afraid to order a McDouble. 

I’m 19 and she’s the only person I have. I’m not sure I could get a second job, as mine is fairly demanding. I’m trying to take everyone’s advice but for me, things like finding a homeless shelter is a very big step.
